title: PageSpec
description: A page composition: an ordered list of section nodes bound to one template. Closed everywhere. `mode` selects reference (faithful reconstruction, real brand and assets allowed as evidence) or generated (nothing may identify or reproduce the source).

mode.description: Required generation context. The schema closes the enum; schema/semantic_validate.py enforces the consequences (GENERATED_MODE_* rules).

theme.description: Token theme. dark is bound to the podcast templates only (tokens/llm/token-policy.json).
